text:
Overhead view of a white plastic platform or fixture plate resting on a dark grey tiled surface (right side and bottom of frame). At left is a long, narrow rectangular recessed slot running vertically. The plate has numerous small drilled holes and shallow circular counterbored recesses distributed across it.

Four square white blocks are mounted on the plate, each with four corner screws. The upper-left block and lower-left block each hold a flat, pale circular disc or cap filling the central bore. The lower-middle block and the upper-right block show open, empty circular cavities with visible interior walls and shadow. At the top edge, partially cut off, are two more white square blocks with pale round features. No liquid is visible.
